title: multi run coord's two research agents work areas whose packs share lack terms, so the scenario's research half measures dedup
goal: the coord scenario's two research areas are two whose question packs share lack terms, so a shared replay leaves a dedup event with an overlap and the paid records can show dedup_hits; the scenario's overlapping-topics line states only an overlap the packs have (reviewer of SP-p46hofrg: pip and uv held dedup_hits 0 and dup_facts 0 in all four paid coord records; operator answer of ST-kx6qdtkv g5 changed to this)

run:
import glob, json, os, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, tempfile
D = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rv-', dir=os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/tmp'))
b = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'multi', *a, '--dir', D], capture_output=True, text=True)
b('run', 'coord', '--replay', '--coord', 'shared')
ev = [json.loads(f) for s in glob.glob(D + '/coord/**/coord.sqlite', recursive=True) for k, f in sqlite3.connect(s).execute('SELECT kind, fields FROM events') if k == 'dedup']
b('remove')
assert any(e.get('overlapping') not in ('-', '', None) for e in ev), ('the coord research agents never overlap', ev)
